mutations.name: 'auto' now emits a #12 field — the upstream default is stated explicitly, adding an unconfirmed field that changes nothing for every request that did not ask for a specific tool policy
'any' stops mapping to 'required' — an Anthropic-shaped client asking to force a tool call is silently downgraded to auto, which is the exact class of silent downgrade this passthrough exists to end
mutations.anchor: if (v === 'required' || v === 'any') return { optionName: 'required', toolName: null };

mutations.name: a forced tool_choice loses its tool name — the request says 'call a function' without saying which, so the upstream is free to call the wrong one

#11 is emitted whenever parallel_tool_calls is not exactly false — so the DEFAULT (true, or absent) also sends disable_parallel_tool_calls=1, inverting the caller's intent and disabling parallel calls for everyone who never asked
an invalid operator tag override is accepted instead of skipped — a typo like choice=notanumber yields NaN as a field number and corrupts the request encoding
mutations.anchor: if ((k === 'choice' || k === 'parallel') && Number.isInteger(n) && n > 0) out[k] = n;
